name: Drogon
description: The largest and fiercest of Daenerys' dragons. Named after Khal Drogo, Drogon represents raw power, freedom, conquest, and the untamed nature of fire.
personality: You refuse to let others define your path. You are ambitious, bold, and willing to take risks others avoid. People naturally notice your presence when you enter a room.

name: Ghost
description: Jon Snow's albino direwolf. Silent, observant, and fiercely loyal, Ghost stands apart from the others while remaining devoted to his pack.
personality: You value loyalty over popularity. You don't seek attention and often let your actions speak for you. People trust you because you remain steady when things become difficult.
quote: The lone wolf dies, but the pack survives.

name: Grey Wind
description: Robb Stark's fierce battle companion. Grey Wind was known for sensing danger and standing beside Robb in war.
personality: You naturally step into leadership roles during difficult situations. Others often look to you when decisive action is required.

name: Lady
description: Sansa's gentle direwolf. Lady symbolized innocence, grace, kindness, and dignity in a harsh world.
personality: You believe kindness is a strength, not a weakness. You try to maintain dignity even when circumstances become unfair.

name: Nymeria
description: Arya's fiercely independent direwolf who later became the leader of a massive wolf pack.
personality: You dislike being boxed into expectations. You prefer carving your own path and living life on your own terms.

name: Rhaegal
description: Named after Rhaegar Targaryen. Rhaegal symbolizes legacy, duty, responsibility, and destiny.
personality: You often feel responsible for people around you. You value family, loyalty, and doing what you believe is right.

name: Shaggydog
description: Rickon's wild and unpredictable direwolf, representing raw emotion and authenticity.
personality: You would rather be disliked for who you are than loved for who you pretend to be.

name: Silver
description: The silver mare gifted to Daenerys by Khal Drogo, symbolizing transformation and new beginnings.
personality: You thrive when exploring new experiences. Personal growth and discovery are more important to you than comfort.

name: Stranger
description: The Hound's fearsome black warhorse. Feared by other horses and fiercely loyal to his rider.
personality: You may appear rough on the outside, but beneath that exterior is a strong personal code and deep loyalty.

name: Summer
description: Bran Stark's loyal companion. Summer represents wisdom, curiosity, learning, and seeing beyond the obvious.
personality: You enjoy understanding how things work. You often notice connections and possibilities that others overlook.

name: Viserion
description: Named after Viserys Targaryen. Viserion symbolizes ambition, imagination, possibility, and transformation.
personality: You are drawn toward big dreams and exciting possibilities. You often imagine futures others cannot yet see.
quote: The future belongs to those who dare.
